numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income: EBIT 2025 = SEK -39,985k (-39.985 million), 2024 = SEK -4,022k (-4.022 million). Rounded figures match.

numerical_claims.claim: Loss for the period attributable to parent company shareholders amounted to SEK -46.1 million, compared to a loss of SEK -5.6 million in the previous year.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income: Profit/Loss for the period attributable to parent shareholders 2025 = SEK -46,091k (-46.091 million), 2024 = SEK -5,582k (-5.582 million). Rounded figures match.

numerical_claims.claim: Earnings per share declined to negative SEK -7.63 from negative SEK -1.00.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 31: Earnings per share 2025 = -7.63 SEK, 2024 = -1.00 SEK.

numerical_claims.claim: Operating cash flow turned negative at SEK -72.6 million, a sharp reversal from the positive SEK 56.8 million generated in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows: Cash flow from operating activities 2025 = SEK -72,600k (-72.6 million), 2024 = SEK 56,789k (56.789 million). Rounded figures match.

numerical_claims.claim: Cash and cash equivalents decreased to SEK 30.1 million from SEK 49.7 million at the end of 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 23 and Consolidated Balance Sheet: Cash and cash equivalents 2025 = SEK 30,117k (30.117 million), 2024 = SEK 49,676k (49.676 million). Rounded figures match.

numerical_claims.claim: Equity ratio improved to 80 percent from 71 percent, supported by two directed share issues that raised approximately SEK 115 million before transaction costs.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: Equity ratio 80% (2025) vs 71% (2024). Note 35: Directed share issues raised SEK 64.5m (June 2025) + SEK 50.3m (December 2025) = SEK 114.8m before transaction costs. Candidate rounding is acceptable.

numerical_claims.claim: Order backlog stood at SEK 352 million at year-end, down from SEK 641 million in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: Order backlog 2025 = SEK 352m, 2024 = SEK 641m.

numerical_claims.claim: EUR 76.3 million order from OHB Sweden for microwave radiometers for the EPS-Sterna weather constellation.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 36: Order from OHB Sweden valued at EUR 76.3 million (approx. SEK 820 million) for delivery of 20 microwave radiometers for EPS-Sterna programme.
